info.description: Errors are RFC 9457 ProblemDetails (`title`, `status`; `errors` for field errors). Lists are `{ items, page, pageSize, total }` with 1-based `page` and `pageSize` <= 100. Unsafe methods need the `X-CSRF-TOKEN` header from `GET /api/v1/identity/antiforgery`.
